text:
I'm sorry, but we can't ship a live plant like a succulent to a PO box. PO boxes are only accepted for non-living items, so the order would need a street address that can receive a courier delivery.

If you have another option, such as a friend's, family member's, or workplace address, you could use that. If you've already placed the order, tell me the order number (it looks like LF-123456) and whether it has shipped. Once an order has shipped, the address can't be changed. If it hasn't shipped yet, support can try to help, but I can't guarantee it.
